title: 包裹送错地址了，英语怎么沟通？
summary: 物流显示送达但你没收到，很可能是送错了。这篇教你跟客服、跟邻居沟通的说法。

phrases.en: It was delivered to the wrong address.
Did you get a package for me by mistake?
phrases.zh: 你有没有误收到我的包裹？

phrases.en: Excuse me, this isn't my package.
phrases.zh: 不好意思，这不是我的包裹。

phrases.en: Please leave it at the front door.

dialogue.speaker: Customer
dialogue.en: Hi, I think my package was misdelivered. It says delivered but I don't have it.
dialogue.zh: 你好，我的包裹好像送错地址了。显示送达了但我没收到。

dialogue.speaker: Neighbor
dialogue.en: Oh! A package came to my house yesterday. Is this yours?
dialogue.zh: 哦！昨天有个包裹送到我家。是你的吗？

dialogue.speaker: Customer
dialogue.en: Yes! That's mine. Thank you so much!

dialogue.speaker: Neighbor
dialogue.en: No problem. The driver left it at my door by mistake.
dialogue.zh: 不客气。快递员放错门口了。

dialogue.speaker: Customer
dialogue.en: I appreciate it. Have a great day!
dialogue.zh: 谢谢你。祝你有愉快的一天！

seoTitle: 包裹送错了英文怎么说？
seoDescription: 包裹被送到邻居家怎么办？本文教你跟客服和邻居沟通的英语说法，附完整对话。
